original.description: German troops being ferried across the Scheldt at Antwerp. The Nationaal Archief record describes a picture postcard reproducing the photograph: "Ansichtkaart met een foto van het transport van Duitse troepen over de Schelde in Antwerpen." Captioned on the card in German and French: "Transport deutscher Truppen über die Schelde in Antwerpen / Anvers - Transport des troupes allemandes".
original.archive: Nationaal Archief (Netherlands), inventory reference Bestanddeelnr 158-1355, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: CC0 1.0 (Commons record: LicenseShortName "CC0"; UsageTerms "Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication").

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is — the source is a printed postcard, and colorizing a halftone reproduction invents detail the print never had.

content_policy: ok — troops crossing a river, no gore
caption: German troops crossing the Scheldt at Antwerp. The card is captioned in German and French for both audiences of an occupied city; the archive dates it only to the war years.
credit: Original photograph: photographer not identified; Nationaal Archief, Bestanddeelnr 158-1355; CC0 / public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. CAUTION for the image review (sand-y0u.7): the archive dates it "between 1914 and 1918", so it may postdate the siege of Antwerp; and the source is a commercially printed postcard, which is a publication, not a negative. The caption claims neither a date nor a moment.
